{{Quote|Let's go home, Ar-Six.|[[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]]|audio=LetsGoHomeArsix-LairOfGrievous.flac|<ref name="Lair of Grievous">{{TCW|Lair of Grievous}}</ref>}}
'''R6-H5''', nicknamed '''Ar-Six''', was the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]]. He accompanied his Master on many missions for the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]]. He was known for being tentative, often worrying about his master, and for having a dislike of strange situations. Ar-Six has a domed R2-series head, typically R6-series astromechs had cone shaped heads similar to the R5-series. It is unknown why Ar-Six has this modification, possibly for use in Fisto's starfighter.

==History==
[[File:R6-H5.png|thumb|left|250px|R6 displaying a hologram of [[Soulless One/Legends|''Soulless One'']].]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Ar-Six and Kit Fisto [[Mission to Grievous's castle/Legends|followed]] a Republic tracking beacon to [[Vassek/Legends|Vassek]], where they believed that [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] was hiding. Master Fisto landed his [[Kit Fisto's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|starfighter]] in the fog and ordered Ar-Six to stay put before he went to meet [[Nahdar Vebb/Legends|Nahdar Vebb]] and his [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] standing by a [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttle]]. When the Jedi and the clones entered [[Grievous's castle/Legends|the nearby facility]], two clones, [[Bel/Legends|Bel]] and [[Niner/Legends|Niner]], stayed behind with R6.

When the clones tracked [[Soulless One/Legends|Grievous' starfighter]] incoming, they reported to [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Fil/Legends|Fil]]. Shortly afterward, [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]' [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]] used a rocket launcher to destroy the shuttle with both clones inside it. When MagnaGuards surrounded the starfighter, Ar-Six received orders from Fisto to fly away, which he performed, shaking off a tenacious MagnaGuard who was clinging to the fighter's hull.

Ar-Six would then circle the area until Fisto ordered Ar-Six to meet him at the nearest landing platform. Once Fisto reached the platform, however, he was confronted by Grievous and his MagnaGuards. At that point in time, Ar-Six arrived in the starfighter, allowing Kit to board it and escape the battle. The two then returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where Fisto reported his former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan's]] [[Death/Legends|death]] to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]].

Later in the Clone Wars, Ar-Six assisted Kit Fisto, [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]], and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] in rescuing [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], and their [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] from a citadel. The rescue resulted in the disclosure of the [[Nexus Route/Legends|Nexus Route]], a hyperspace lane that led to the heart of both factions in the war.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:R6-H5_dome.png|thumb|left|180px|R6-H5]]

Although his dome seems to be of an R2 unit and not the typical, slightly conical "flowerpot" shape of the R6, if R6-H5 is indeed an [[R6-series astromech droid]], and not just an earlier model with an "R6" designation, his inclusion poses a continuity problem, as R6 units had not been created until the later stages of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
Alternately, [[Pablo Hidalgo]]'s revelation that droid names are fragments of longer designations could also provide an explanation for this apparent lack of continuity.<ref name="SWI">[[Star Wars Insider 58|''Star Wars Insider'' 58]]</ref>

Coincidentally enough, R6-H5 shares the "H5" with Kit Fisto's other droid, [[R4-H5/Legends|R4-H5]].

R6-H5 appears in ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'', in the [[Vassek]] level "Lair of Grievous". Although he is not playable during this scenario, he can be found in the [[Resolute]] (Reactor Chamber) game hub and purchased for 35,000 studs, becoming a playable character. He has orange legs instead of brown. R6-H5 also appears as an NPC, sat in the co-pilot seat of Kit Fisto's Starfighter, which can be piloted by the player.
